name: Larry Status
author: Larry & Fred
description: Larry's control room: service health (qdrant, ollama, backups), brain state (loaded model, LMF memory), and one-click actions (heartbeat, btrfs snapshot, vicup save). Left-click = panel, middle-click = instant heartbeat.

barWidget.description: Green robot = qdrant, ollama, and backups all healthy. Red = something is down. Dimmed = heartbeat stale.
